name: Josek
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Josek is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke, chapter 3. He is listed as the son of Joda and the father of Semein. Little is known about him beyond his place in the lineage connecting Jesus with the patriarchs of old.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Josek is listed in Luke's genealogy as one of Jesus' ancestors, placed between Joda and Semein in the lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage from David to Jesus
keyEvents.description: Josek is part of the long lineage that Luke traces back from Jesus through David all the way to Adam, to show Jesus' connection to all humanity.

keyEvents.title: The link between God's promises and their fulfillment
keyEvents.description: As part of the genealogy, Josek's place testifies to God's faithfulness in fulfilling the promises of a Messiah through an unbroken lineage.

keyEvents.title: An Unknown Faithful Ancestor
keyEvents.description: Although little is known about Josek's life, his inclusion in the genealogy testifies that God uses ordinary and unknown people in His plan of salvation.
